title: Enabling Stablecoin Payments for a Global Fintech Platform
highlight: Launched a scalable, enterprise-grade stablecoin payment rail through a single integration
customerProfile: A global fintech platform wanted to introduce stablecoins as an additional payment rail for its customers without disrupting its existing payment experience. The objective was to launch a scalable, enterprise-grade solution through a single integration while maintaining operational efficiency and customer trust.
challenge: Supporting stablecoin payments required much more than enabling deposits and withdrawals. The platform needed to process high-value customer transactions while managing payment exceptions, irreversible blockchain transfers, fraud scenarios, and operational workflows at scale, all without increasing manual effort or impacting the customer experience.
solution: Pay3 provided a unified Stablecoin Payments API that enabled the platform to: accept and process stablecoin deposits and withdrawals through a single integration; automatically reconcile incoming transactions against merchant instructions; handle underpayments, overpayments, and refund requests through configurable workflows; automate the handling of payment exceptions, disputes, and operational reviews; and provide complete transaction visibility and end-to-end audit trails across the payment lifecycle.
businessImpact:
• Introduced stablecoins as an additional payment option through a single API integration
  • Automated reconciliation for the majority of incoming transactions
  • Standardized workflows for payment exceptions and refund requests
  • Reduced manual intervention in transaction processing and investigations
  • Improved operational visibility with end-to-end transaction tracking
